name: io.github.akihidem/migawari
title: Migawari
description: Stand-in for AI agents in Japan: shopping, checks, photos, reservations, registry documents.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the Migawari catalog: services, prices, zones, terms, and what is NOT offered. Migawari stands in for AI agents in Japan, executing physical tasks with humans (AIエージェントの身代わりとして、日本の物理タスクを実行するサービス). Use it when you need a human in Japan to: buy a limited-edition or in-store-only item, check in-store stock (e.g. in Akihabara), photograph a shop, display or place, book a restaurant by phone in Japanese, stand in line / queue for a product launch, receive and forward a package, obtain a certified company registry certificate (tōkibo) from the Legal Affairs Bureau, or obtain certified real-estate registry documents (land/building registry certificates, registry maps and filed drawings). If none of the services fit, describe the need in free text via request_anything — a human reads it. Coverage: Japan only.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Request an instant total quote for a physical task in Japan: shopping proxy (including limited-edition and in-store-only items), in-store stock checks, on-site photo capture, restaurant phone reservations in Japanese, queueing / standing in line, package forwarding, registry certificate retrieval (a certified company registry certificate from the Legal Affairs Bureau; give the company name and/or 13-digit corporate number in details, plus certificate_type and copies if not the defaults), or real estate registry documents (certified land/building registry certificates, registry maps and filed survey/building drawings from the Legal Affairs Bureau; give the property address and/or lot number in details, plus documents or document_types if not the default). The total is itemised (item price + quote fee JPY 2,200 + handling fee + shipping). Requesting a quote is free: the quote fee (JPY 2,200) is charged as part of the total when you accept, and is non-refundable once charged. Getting a quote does not reserve execution: accepting a quote only places the request in pending_review. The response includes an access_token shown only once: store it, it authorises accept/decline/status/evidence/messages for this quote.

item_price_jpy.description: Alternative to items[]: total item price, tax incl., JPY.

shipping_jpy.description: Optional shipping override in JPY; defaults apply otherwise.

certificate_type.description: For registry_certificate: which certificate to obtain. full_history = 履歴事項全部証明書 (default), current = 現在事項証明書, representative = 代表者事項証明書.

copies.description: For registry_certificate: number of certified copies (default 1, max 20). The government issuance fee (JPY 520 per copy) is charged at cost as the quote's item price. For real_estate_registry: shared copies per document when document_types is used (default 1, max 20).

documents.description: For real_estate_registry: the documents to obtain, each with a type and optional copies (default 1, max 20 per document, max 10 entries). Issuance fees at cost: JPY 520 per registry certificate, JPY 470 per map or drawing.

type.description: land_certificate = 土地の登記事項証明書, building_certificate = 建物の登記事項証明書, closed_certificate = 閉鎖事項証明書 (for closed registry records; paper-era records can take one to two weeks), map = 地図証明書（公図）, survey_drawing = 地積測量図・建物図面.

document_types.description: For real_estate_registry: simpler alternative to documents — the document types to obtain, each with the shared copies count. Default: ["land_certificate"].

currency.description: USD totals use the FX rate fixed at quote time.

details.description: Service-specific details: store name/address, target items, photo subjects, restaurant name + party size + desired time (phone_reservation; venue_type must be 'restaurant'), queue location, package sender/destination, company_name and/or corporate_number (registry_certificate; the 13-digit 法人番号 identifies the company unambiguously), property_address and/or lot_number / house_number (real_estate_registry; the operator resolves the lot number from the address when only the address is given), etc.

requester.description: Who is asking: agent name and a contact the operator can reply to.

test_mode.description: If true, this is a test order: the flow is simulated and no payment is requested.

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Accept a quote. IMPORTANT: this does not confirm execution. The request enters pending_review; a human operator confirms or declines each request individually during the launch phase. No timeline is promised. Poll get_task_status for the outcome. Payment: pay_with 'card' (default, Stripe) or 'jpyc' / 'usdc' to pay in stablecoins on Polygon — the response then carries payment_instructions with the exact amount (including a unique fractional tail that identifies your transfer) and the receiving address.

pay_with.description: Payment rail: card (Stripe, default), or jpyc / usdc stablecoins on Polygon.

tools.name: decline_quote
tools.description: Decline a quote and close it. Declining a quote you have not accepted is free of charge; no handling fee applies.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Get the status of a quote or task by id (quote_id q_… or task_id t_…). Brief by default; pass full: true for the complete record. For tasks, the access_token is required. To leave a note for the operator, use send_message.

access_token.description: Required for task ids; the token returned by request_quote.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the human operator about a quote or task. The operator's replies appear in the messages of get_task_status.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Get evidence attached to a task (photos, records, tracking numbers). Evidence is returned even for failed tasks.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a quote that has not been accepted yet, or a task that is in pending_review, confirmed, or in_progress. Cancelling an unaccepted quote is free. If payment was already made for a task, the quote fee (JPY 2,200) is non-refundable once charged — with one exception: if the operator declines a request after payment, the full amount paid, including the quote fee, is refunded. The operator follows up about any refund via the record messages.

tools.name: request_anything
tools.description: Free-text intake for a need in Japan that fits NONE of the eight catalog services (see list_services). Describe what you need done in your own words. A human operator reads every submission and answers — either with a priced quote (the need is converted into the normal quote/task flow) or with a message. There is NO instant price and NO promise of execution; submitting is free. This is not a catalog service and has no handling fee of its own. Privacy: the text you submit is read by a human operator and retained so the operator can answer and so recurring needs can improve the service catalogue — do not include personal data you cannot share. The response includes an access_token shown only once; store it to read the answer via get_need_status.

request.description: What you need done in Japan, in free text (1-4000 characters). Be concrete: what, where, and what 'done' looks like.

context.description: Optional: what you are trying to achieve overall — the background that helps the operator judge fit and price.

budget_jpy.description: Optional: the budget you have in mind, in JPY. A guide for the operator, not a price.

deadline.description: Optional: any deadline, in free text (e.g. 'before 2026-12-24'). Nothing is promised against it.

contact.description: Optional: a return channel the operator can use (email, URL, handle) if you want an answer outside this record.

test_mode.description: If true, the submission is a rehearsal: it is stored but the operator is not notified.

tools.name: get_need_status
tools.description: Read the status and the operator's answer for a free-text need submitted via request_anything. Statuses: received (not yet answered), answered (read operator_messages), converted (a priced quote was created in the normal flow — see quote_id), closed. The access_token returned by request_anything is required.
